parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of incorrect allow_migrate() calls in makemigrations. The changes are minimal and focused on the reported problem.

issues.description: The change in django/db/migrations/operations/base.py from allow_migrate_model to allow_migrate may not align with the project's convention, as allow_migrate_model is more specific to models.
